label: Stabbing queries
subgoals: Compare the query with each interval's left endpoint
Compare it with each interval's right endpoint
Count the intervals that contain the query point

label: Building a centred interval tree
subgoals: Choose the centre at the median endpoint
Keep the intervals that contain the centre at the root
Send the rest to the left or right subtree

label: Querying the root
subgoals: Decide which side of the centre the query lies on
Scan the matching sorted endpoint list until the first failure
Count the intervals reported at the root
